site.name: When Light Breaks
site.description: Official website of When Light Breaks, an independent four-piece alternative metal band formed in New York in 2026.

artist.name: When Light Breaks
artist.description: When Light Breaks blends metalcore, djent, and deathcore with cinematic atmospheres and electronic textures. The band explores identity, human emotion, personal experience, social contradictions, and the fragile boundary between perception and reality.
